finders_eat_first.cost: everyone else loses 1 morale when they come home
finders_eat_first.name: Finders eat first
finders_eat_first.narrator_line: Finders eat first. The shelter now has a class system.

kids_eat_last.bonus: a skipped child's ration only counts every other day
kids_eat_last.cost: children's morale stays at 5 or below
kids_eat_last.name: Kids eat last
kids_eat_last.narrator_line: The children were not consulted. They noticed anyway.

nobody_opens_hatch.bonus: events can't give the hatch away
nobody_opens_hatch.cost: no visitors, trades or favours at the door
nobody_opens_hatch.name: Nobody opens the hatch
nobody_opens_hatch.narrator_line: The hatch is now a wall with ambitions.

occupied_fair_game.bonus: trips take 50% more from homes people still live in
occupied_fair_game.cost: the explorer carries Guilt and the neighbourhood rescue is lost
occupied_fair_game.name: Occupied homes are fair game

pet_ration.bonus: when the food runs out, the dog becomes 8 rations (the cat 4)
pet_ration.cost: everyone loses 3 morale when it happens
pet_ration.name: The pet is an emergency ration
pet_ration.narrator_line: Nobody voted for it. Nobody voted against it either.

sick_sleep_upstairs.bonus: sickness can't spread or come back
sick_sleep_upstairs.cost: the sick lose 1 morale every night
sick_sleep_upstairs.name: The sick sleep upstairs
sick_sleep_upstairs.narrator_line: Upstairs has a draft, a view, and very few visitors.

work_or_dont_eat.name: Work or don't eat
work_or_dont_eat.narrator_line: Productivity is up. Nobody can say what is being produced.
